errors: Crossed-out line 'δ0p0 = p12δ1 = p12ρδ1 = p12ρ²δ1' is wrong: p12δ1 = σ and p12ρ²δ1 = id_{E1}; only p12ρδ1 = δ0p0. Grothendieck caught this ('??') and corrected it in the boxed list.
The suspected non-associativity '(p12ρ)δ1 ≠ p12(ρδ1)' is spurious: both sides equal δ0p0 (p23δ1 = p12δ3). It is crossed out.
All boxed final relations check out against the explicit formulas.
There is no claim that the boxed list is a complete presentation; completeness (that all relations of ΔS_{≤2} follow) is not verified on the page.

ideas.what: Coskeletal model E0 = X, E1 = X², E2 = X³ with S2 and S3 actions, faces given by projections and degeneracies by diagonals
ideas.modern_name: 2-truncated symmetric simplicial set (coskeleton / pair groupoid with symmetries)
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard; symmetric simplicial sets, e.g. Grandis; crossed simplicial groups (Fiedorowicz–Loday 1991, Krasauskas 1987)

ideas.what: Presentation of the symmetric truncated simplex category by the generators p0, p12, δ0, δ1 plus group actions, with explicit relations
ideas.modern_name: generators and relations for ΔS (symmetric crossed simplicial group) truncated at level 2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Fiedorowicz–Loday (crossed simplicial groups); folklore for FinSet presentations

ideas.what: Use of such half-simplicial symmetric data as the global combinatorial formalism for stratified structures (pairs and triples of strata), before introducing tubes
ideas.modern_name: combinatorial/exit-path style description of stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: MacPherson, Treumann, Lurie (exit paths); the 'tame topology' programme of the Esquisse
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 discusses stratified structures but not this formalism

missed.claim: Grothendieck independently writes down a presentation of the 2-truncated symmetric simplex category (in effect the crossed simplicial group ΔS) as the skeleton for his 'formalisme ½ simplicial' of stratifications. This is around the same time as Fiedorowicz–Loday and Krasauskas. It is a minor historical datum; the mathematics itself is routine.
missed.quote: Il suffit d'avoir p0, p12, δ0, δ1 entre les trois ensembles E0, (E1,S2), (E2,S3), avec les relations
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Documents that Grothendieck's stratification programme was meant to rest on symmetric (not merely ordered) simplicial data. This is of minor historical interest only.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine verification of identities in a symmetric truncated simplicial structure, including a caught-and-corrected slip. Interesting only as context for the unpublished 'Structures stratifiées' plan.
transcription_corrections: 'δ3δ3' near the top right is more likely 'σ3 δ3' (the first symbol is an overwritten σ/δ).
In the image the δ-relation block is written with corrected indices: δ1 = ρδ2 = ρ²δ3; δ2 = ρδ3 = ρ²δ1; δ3 = ρδ1 = ρ²δ2 (the transcription matches after the overwriting).
The boxed relation reads 'σ1 δ1 = δ1', with the subscript 1 overwriting a 3.
In the final line the underbraced label under p0 p12 appears to be a projection label (likely p1 or p2), not certain.
'Il suffit de avoir' should read 'Il suffit d'avoir'.
